description:
Create a new tax (TVA/VAT) entry in Ekylibre with the following details:

1. Navigate to the Tax configuration section (typically under Accounting > Configuration or similar).
2. Create a new tax with these specific parameters:
   - Name: "TVA Réduite Alimentaire 5.5%"
   - Rate/Amount: 5.5 (percent)
   - Nature: Normal VAT (or default/standard option)
   - Country: France
3. For the "Collect account" and "Deduction account" fields, select any available VAT-related accounts from the dropdowns (e.g., accounts starting with 445...).
4. Save the new tax entry.

The Ekylibre instance is located at http://demo.ekylibre.farm:3000.
Login credentials (if needed):
- Email: admin@ekylibre.org
- Password: 12345678
